description: The official online court case search for a U.S. state or the District of Columbia: who runs it, what a member of the public can find there, and what it costs, each fact with the court page it was read from and the day it was read. Give a state's name or two-letter code, or omit it for every state. Federal cases are on PACER, not here.

state.description: A state's name or two-letter postal code, for example Illinois or IL. Omit for every state.

name: court_records_search
title: Find a state's official court records search
